content:
Ana: Locking webinar microformat. 40m content / 15m Q&A. Well do 3 micro-demos (90s live + 30s takeaway) spread across the session. Assets due Thu EOD.
Jared: Confirming asset list?
Ana: 1) 2-slide storyboard PDF per demo; 2) prompts.txt (happy, edge, fallback); 3) expected_output.md (one short example per prompt); 4) recorded fallback mp4; 5) short bio + headshot.
Lina: For prompts.txt format, something like: 
```
happy: "Summarize this release note in 3 bullets for PMs"
edge: "Release note is 5k chars - extract top 3 impact points"
fallback: "If latency >600ms use compact-v2"
success: "3 concise bullets, no hallucinations"
```
Dustin: Who owns switching fallback live if latency spikes?
Ana: Infra will monitor p95; if >500ms tag @Dustin and OpsBot will point demo to recorded mp4. Also include test harness URL in your asset zip.
Jared: Rehearsals: propose Tue 14:00 speaker-only micro-runs, Thu 10:00 full dress. OpsBot can create invites.
OpsBot: Post preferred 2-hour windows and Ill create Zoom events labelled #webinar-rehearsal and attach the checklist.
Lina: Also want the expected token counts per prompt so marketing can estimate cost.
Ana: add expected_tokens.txt to the zip (p50/p95 token counts). Keep numbers approximate.
Dustin: Runbook note: if model stalls >10s/token, call recorded demo and continue Q&A. Capture which fallback used in postmortem.
Jared: Q&A flow idea: start with 3 audience poll questions (hosted in chat), then product-focused Qs, finish with deep technical prompts routed to infra SME. Ill moderate.
Ana: Targets: 50% registrant->attendee, 95% live demo success (no fallback), 40% MQLs from engaged attendees. Well log latency + model variant per prompt.
Lina: Dropping my asset zip by Thu EOD. Tagging OpsBot for Tue/Thu slots.
Ana: Excellent. Speakers: drop assets here and ping OpsBot with rehearsal windows. Thanks! :rocket:
